distribution.summary: 重庆；福建；广东；广西；海南；上海；云南；香港；台湾
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Chongqing, Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, Shanghai, Yunnan, Hong Kong and Taiwan, plus one unresolved 'unknown province' record. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently reports the first Taiwan record from Nantou (Hui Son). Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: No host is reported in the promoted Smith record. Beaver & Liu (2010) describes the species as polyphagous but enumerates no host taxon; no host is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xyleborinus artestriatus (Eichhoff, 1878).

nomenclature_note: Canonical identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Xyleborinus artestriatus (Eichhoff, 1878), VSN_6048. Beaver & Liu (2010) additionally synonymizes Xyleborus beaveri Browne under Xyleborinus artestriatus after type comparisons; retained as source-specific taxonomic provenance.
